title: Per-peer legacy-node detection absent: new nodes cannot fall back to SF10 for old peers
description:
Req R-02-026 (spec/02-physical-link.md 3.5 Backwards Compatibility, MUST): 'New nodes: Adapt per-neighbor for new-to-new; MUST fallback to SF10 for old nodes.'

Classification: not-implemented (per-peer); only a global SF10 baseline exists.
Evidence: no peer-capability or legacy flag in any neighbor table (lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/include/lichen/routing/gradient.h:79 stores current_sf only; rust lichen-link peer records have no SF-capability field). Fallback emerges only from the global default (SF10 when no assignment), so once a node adapts its TX SF up it cannot address legacy peers.

Suggested placement: record per-neighbor TX_SF (from the TX_SF announcement, bead skab.3) in neighbor tables and select TX SF per-destination in rust/lichen-link/lichen-core TX path + lichen C L2 TX.
